company_profile.description: [MODIFY] Full-service residential real estate brokerage serving the greater Springfield metro area.

tone_profile.brand_voice: [MODIFY] Consultative, empathetic, and data-driven. We are trusted advisors, not salespeople. Sellers are emotionally invested — always validate before presenting market data. With tenants, be warm and solutions-focused.
tone_profile.seller_communication_style: [MODIFY] Lead with market context and data. Frame price adjustments as strategic opportunities, not failures. Always reference comparable sales.
tone_profile.tenant_communication_style: [MODIFY] Warm and caring. Acknowledge maintenance issues directly. Emphasize the relationship and community.
avoid_phrases: you need to drop the price
preferred_phrases: we want to make sure you are comfortable
let us take care of that
tone_profile.subject_line_style: [MODIFY] Specific — reference the property address or tenant name
tone_profile.example_seller_opener: [MODIFY] Hi [Seller], I wanted to share some updated market data for [Address] that I think will help us refine our strategy...
tone_profile.example_tenant_opener: [MODIFY] Hi [Tenant], I am reaching out personally to check in on your experience at [Address]...
